implementation_summary: rewrite-api.ts: listRewrites/approveRewrite/writeNewCopy/acceptNewCopy against AUDIT_API routes, refusals turned into plain sentences (ERR_NO_AI_KEY -> 'Add an AI key in Settings to write new copy.', ERR_OVERLAP -> server message plus validated overlaps, AI failure -> reply sentence or generic AI_UNAVAILABLE). writeNewCopy sends no request unless the RewriteState is approved. markCopiedPhrases matches the normalised OverlapFlag words to word runs in the displayed text (same normalisation as the core overlapWords) and merges them into marked pieces. RewriteReview.tsx: pure RewriteReviewView (original text, Approve rewrite, Write new copy disabled until approved with aria-describedby reason, proposal with <mark aria-label> highlights plus a phrase list with word counts, labelled textarea, Accept, ERR_OVERLAP refusal that keeps the edited text and marks the phrases still copied, Audit Documents only notice) and a stateful RewriteReview that loads the saved rewrites and handles approve/write/accept.
